question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle PQR with (BC)/(QR)=(1)/(5).(Area (triangle PQR))/(Area (triangle ABC)) is:
solution:
Given:

 (BC)/(QR)=(1)/(5).(Area (triangle PQR))/(Area (triangle ABC))

Concept used:

(Area of ABC)/(Area of PQR) = (AB)²/(PQ)² = (BC)²/(QR)² = (AC)²/(PR)²

Calculations:

Using the Formulae we get,

⇒ (Area of PQR)/(Area of ABC) = (5)²/(1)²

⇒ (Area of PQR)/(Area of ABC) = 25

∴ The answer is 25 cm.
